name: Sango Shizen Foundation Nature Coexistence Activity Grant

funder.name: Sango Shizen Foundation (公益財団法人 三五自然共生財団)

summary: Japanese foundation grant of up to JPY 1.5 million per theme (about six awards) for tree planting and biotope creation, satoyama and rare-habitat protection, invasive species control, plus survey and education themes, for a one-year project.

amount.note: Up to JPY 1.5 million per theme, about 6 awards.

reporting: A results report is due after the project ends, by 10 May of the following year, and a results presentation is held the next summer.
